beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A young man named Jeremiah felt far too small for the job. God was calling him to speak to nations, and he was certain he could not do it.

timing.text: A young man named Jeremiah felt far too small for the job.
God was calling him to speak to nations, and he was certain he could not do it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But the call did not begin the day he heard it. Long before he was born, before he ever drew a breath, the plan was already set.

timing.text: But the call did not begin the day he heard it.
Long before he was born, before he ever drew a breath, the plan was already set.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The God who made him had already chosen him — and blessing, not pressure, was the shape of it.

timing.text: The God who made him had already chosen him — and blessing, not pressure, was the shape of it.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

timing.text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read that again slowly. Before you were ever born, I set you apart, and I gave you this work. God is telling a frightened young man that they had already met — long before anybody in Jerusalem knew his name.

timing.text: Before you were ever born, I set you apart, and I gave you this work.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

timing.text: behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jeremiah answered that he was only a child.

timing.text: Jeremiah answered that he was only a child.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

timing.text: Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The LORD replied — go where I send you, speak what I command, and do not be afraid, for I am with you to deliver you.

timing.text: The LORD replied — go where I send you, speak what I command, and do not be afraid, for I am with you to deliver you.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

timing.text: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same God who knew you before you were born is the one who walks with you now. The calling is His; the courage is His gift.

timing.text: The same God who knew you before you were born is the one who walks with you now.

card.text: You were known before you were born. You are not too small for what He has for you.
